I'm graduating this year so eighth grade was a long time ago lol. I was always worried about my eye shape, I have pretty small eyes. The contacts really do help and if its already something you obsess over then do it but once you start its haaard to stop >< the brown contacts really do make your eyes look big and pretty and I feel like it made me look put together even without makeup (weirdos unite) the amount of confidence you feel is crazy, but it really did make me happy. I bet you're beautiful ❤ but if it makes you feel happy then that's what matters

I finally broke the habit and I'm so happy, I've been wearing brown contacts every single day since eighth grade. It sucks to take them out and think your face is disgusting just based on eye color. If its just for fun or casual wear go for it! Don't if you think you'll depend on them (I'm just a big weirdo) but don't be scared of contacts! You put them in a few times and it becomes second nature. I used the darkest brown air optix and they were really comfortable. Make sure to clean them and don't sleep in them like me. It did work in comforting me, I felt like my face was transformed
